title: Application of caffeic acid derivative in preparation of medicine for treating gonorrhea
abstract: The invention discloses an application of a caffeic acid derivative in preparation of a medicine for treating gonorrhea. The caffeic acid derivative is shown as a formula (I). The compound of formula (2) in the caffeic acid derivatives of the present invention has extremely strong bactericidal activity against Neisseria gonorrhoeae in vitro, so that the caffeic acid derivative has a wide application prospect in preparation of medicines for treating infectious diseases caused by gonococcus.
